attribution.conclusion: The two references differ by more than the gate limit itself, so a gate reading 'MAE > 0.15' cannot be attributed to the solver: changing only the reference moves the MAE by 0.533, a shift of the same order as the failure margin. The B2 physical-validation verdict therefore stays withheld until a scatter-bearing, citable reference is installed.
